The map and index never vary with your focus; your per-call material is at the end.

^-marked entries are compressed stubs carrying child addresses. Their narration and any surfaced witness quotes are verbatim-accurate — quote them as-is — but a stub carries no provenance (source, date, supersession). Expand (aswritten_expand with the IRIs you need) before any claim that turns on WHEN or by WHOM something was said, or whether it is still the current framing. Witness-depth sections below already carry full provenance.

Deciding where to go: each mapped area's narration tells you the SPAN of what lives under it; the area index names everything else. Expand a subtree when its narration (or name) shows your subject plausibly lives there — you'll get the trajectory, the variants, and the verbatim witness. But be strict about absence: if neither the map's narrations nor the index's names substantively cover your subject, it is NOT in this perspective — say so rather than expanding a loose thematic match (a word-overlap is not coverage). positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceAsset
positions.frame: what is the value distinction between the intelligence/perspective one keeps and the substrate/intelligence one merely rents or passes through?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same matched-antithesis maxim (owned/rented; commodity/asset) that the register pass flags as a shared aphoristic-technical signature and the value pass reads as the same autonomy/self-enhancement appeal — ownership of perspective framed as the thing worth keeping against a commoditized substrate. Conviction readings differ in degree (src-2 a flat claim, src-3 a creed-like principle) rather than in direction, so the set holds that gradient in tension under one frame rather than resolving it.

positions.name: PipelinePositioningMetaNote
positions.frame: what function does this text serve within the navigation/provenance regression pipeline that will read it?
positions.why: Both expressions step outside the thesis content to describe the document's own instrumental role — src-1 names itself a positioning note for the navigation/provenance regression guard, src-4 explains it restates the thesis so a navigating extractor has prior positioning to connect to. Both share the same footing (Xena as animator and author, no distinct principal) and both land at the weakest, most meta-instrumental conviction level (notion) rather than asserting anything about owned/rented intelligence itself — a self-referential frame distinct from the thesis the note restates.

placements.title: Durable value shifts from the substrate you rent to the perspective you own and keep
placements.frame: Does the expression locate the actor's durable value in a perspective they own and retain, versus a substrate or access they merely rent or pass through?
placements.why: Both segments carry the same content thesis — an owned/rented intelligence distinction (src-2) elaborated into a commodity-substrate vs. kept-asset-perspective framing (src-3). This is a genuine subject future envelopes in this repo would keep feeding (the individually-owned-intelligence thesis the document itself names as prior positioning), not a one-time fact — it names a durable value distinction, not a measurement or event. No existing narrative leaf or strata category was supplied to hold it (both graph structure and strata are empty for this repo), so no reuse is possible; the register and value dimensional passes independently mark this exact pairing as a shared aphoristic/autonomy-and-ownership signature, reinforcing that it is a real recurring theme rather than incidental phrasing. Minted standalone: nothing existing is even close enough to warrant a lineage edge, and no hub or strata mint is warranted from this single probe envelope's sparse content.
